'''Nari Strade''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an armsmaster in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war she worked as a [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where she ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Strade had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tanned skin. While at her stall she wore a white and blue uniform including a helmet.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armsmaster Nari Strade appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Nari Strade was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> Her position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', which labeled her as Nari Strade.<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
